category: Setting up a ledger in a project

history.name: No taxonomy out of the box
history.description: A new ledger starts with no categories at all. The areas a product divides into are decided by looking at that product, so the first survey of the codebase is what defines them — rather than a supplied default taxonomy that would fit nothing exactly and quietly become the one nobody revisits.
history.dev_notes: config.categories is written as [] by cmdInit, deliberately, and `ledger add` refuses a category that isn't in the list.
